safety_guards: Do not add services to skillful-motivation.
Do not clone or import the BNA production database.
Do not print or pass secret values on the command line.
Do not create real Zoom meetings, send email/WhatsApp, charge cards, or upload Vimeo videos during UI-review provisioning.
Do not attach join.onetimeonetime.com before verifying the command is scoped to the One Time web service.

planned_steps.note: Run only if railway list --json proves no intended One Time project exists.
Use a temp link directory or an explicit One Time project token; never link to the shared project.
Create or verify the one-time-postgres Postgres service in the One Time project.
Create or verify the one-time-web application service in the One Time project.

planned_steps.command: railway variable set --service one-time-web --environment production --skip-deploys APP_MODE=single_tenant APP_INSTANCE=onetime DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_KEY=rabbi_sheller_provider DEFAULT_PROJECT_KEY=one_time_mishnah_class ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=join.onetimeonetime.com BRAND_KEY=onetime PUBLIC_LANGUAGE=en BNA_RAILWAY_PROCESS=web BNA_COOKIE_SECURE=true STUDENT_BOT_ENABLED=false BNA_ACCOUNTABILITY_ENABLED=false SEFARIA_STUDY_ASSISTANT_ENABLED=false APP_URL=https://join.onetimeonetime.com BNA_APP_URL=https://join.onetimeonetime.com NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://join.onetimeonetime.com PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://join.onetimeonetime.com APP_BASE_URL=https://join.onetimeonetime.com
planned_steps.note: Safe to print; values are non-secret One Time runtime flags and public URLs.

planned_steps.command: railway variable set --service one-time-web --environment production --skip-deploys DATABASE_URL=${{ one-time-postgres.DATABASE_URL }}
planned_steps.note: Use the Railway service reference for the One Time Postgres database.
Set each required secret through stdin or approved Railway secret tooling. Do not print values.
Only set optional integration credentials that already exist in approved secure storage.

planned_steps.command: railway up . --project <one-time-production-project-id> --service one-time-web --environment production --detach --message One Time pilot review deployment
planned_steps.note: Deploy the canonical branch; do not merge PR #5.
Capture fresh CNAME/TXT records returned for this exact service.

database_steps: Run npm run one-time:db:bootstrap -- --json first to review migration checksums without mutating the database.

After the separate One Time database is available, run npm run one-time:db:bootstrap -- --apply --confirm BOOTSTRAP_ONE_TIME_DATABASE with APP_INSTANCE=onetime, DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_KEY=rabbi_sheller_provider, and DEFAULT_PROJECT_KEY=one_time_mishnah_class.

Confirm the bootstrap report applies the existing migration chain, ops/one-time-mishnah/separate-instance-seed.sql, and ops/one-time-mishnah/separate-instance-isolation-scan.sql with zero BNA-private rows.
remaining_blockers: Railway account auth must allow railway list/init/add/variable/up/domain for the One Time project.
Manual DNS remains separate after Railway returns fresh join.onetimeonetime.com records.
